metadata.value: Train. If you want to train the model from scratch. Please apply a two-stage training scheme: 1) train a basic model without relation attendance, and 2) load the reconstruction part of the pre-trained model to learn the whole model (with the same lr_rate). For implementation, please turn off/on ```[pretrain] in line 52 of ground.py```, and switch between ```line 6 & 7 in ground_relation.py```  for 1st & 2nd stage training respectively. Also, you need to change the model files in ```line 69 & 70 of ground_relation.py``` to the best model obtained at the first stage for 2nd-stage training.
